task.ques: Find the lowest fare from all eligible one-way flights for 1 adult from JFK to Heathrow on Jun. 22.

claude.final_answer:
FINAL: The lowest displayed fare is US$385 one way for 1 adult in Economy from JFK to London Heathrow (LHR) on June 22, 2027 (the next June 22). One option is Virgin Atlantic, departing 8:05 AM and arriving 8:00 PM the same day, nonstop, 6 hr 55 min. Other flights share the displayed $385 minimum.

Evidence: Google Flights, Cheapest tab, All flights sorted by price, with no additional filters. The fare includes required taxes and fees; the Virgin Atlantic fare excludes overhead-bin access. Screenshot: ./final.png. Viewed October 27, 2026.
Source: https://www.google.com/travel/flights/search?tfs=CBwQAhoeEgoyMDI3LTA2LTIyagcIARIDSkZLcgcIARIDTEhSQAFIAXABggELCP___________wGYAQI&tfu=EgoIAhAAGAAgAigB&curr=USD
